subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR's phase-aware stuck-recovery classification become the supported replay boundary for diagnostic recovery?
rationale: The patch now matches the maintainer's requested shape, but deciding that active model-call stalls may use idle-timeout fallback while side-effecting tool stalls may not is an agent/session policy choice with session-state and availability impact.

options.title: Accept Phase-Aware Boundary
options.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported recovery behavior.

options.title: Require Broader Runtime Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until broader runtime proof covers additional model-call, tool-call, stale recovery, and reply-run fallback paths against the latest main.

options.title: Pause For Recovery Timing
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 settles if maintainers want recovery timing to define the final behavior first.

recommendation.title: Accept Phase-Aware Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after owner review with the current model-call versus side-effecting-tool distinction as the supported recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, own the prior replay-safety review requirement in the discussion, and have recent diagnostic recovery history.
